## Purpose

Repeat placebo model fitting with standardized socioeconomic/demographic covariates. Save covariate-adjusted prediction rows for comparison with the outcome-history-only models.

DATA
```{r}
# Load the panel, spatial graph and placebo assignments; standardize uemp, pov, mhinc and aian.
# Configure the same history lags used by the no-covariate branch.
dt <- readRDS("data/notpublic/compact_dt.rds") |> data.table()
dt$year |> summary()
dt$start_year |> table()

dt[, y0_25 := NULL]
dt[, y0 := NULL]
dt |> set_y0()
table(dt$year < dt$start_year, is.na(dt$y0))

load("data/W")
rownames(W) <- NULL
conf <- list(Lset = choose_lset(dt, shift_max = 3), graph = Matrix(W))
options(xpn.conf = conf)

sim_out <- readRDS("data/simulation/simulated_assignments_with_meta.rds")
sim_out$metadata
sim_a <- sim_out$assignments
dt[i %in% 1:50] |> plot_assignment_diff(sim_a[, 1, 1])

colnames(dt) <- tolower(colnames(dt))
dt[, nc := ordered(urb != "6.NonCore", labels = c("NonCore", "Core"))]
dt[, ":=" (uemp = scale(uemp)
           , pov = scale(pov), mhinc = scale(mhinc), aian = scale(aian))]
```


```{r}
# Define fit_sim(): apply each saved assignment, fit replications in parallel, and save model/scenario wcov_imputation RDS files.
# Retain only years before observed adoption, so withheld placebo outcomes remain verifiable.
fit_sim <- function(
  fit_fun_sim
  , nboot = 200
  , nrep = 200
  , keep = c("i", "year", "start_year", "start_year_sim"
    , "urb", "y", "n", "y0_hat", paste0("y0_post_", 1:nboot)
  )
  , mc_cores = 18
  , worlds = 1:3
  , file_name = NULL
  , ...
) {
  for (k in worlds) {
    start_all <- Sys.time()
    result <- mclapply(1:nrep, \(r) {
      dt |> set_y0(A_sim = sim_a[, r, k])
      #is_test_set <- is.na(dt$y0) & dt$year < dt$start_year
      #sum(is_test_set)
      dt |> fit_fun_sim(nboot = nboot, ...)
      pre <- dt$year < dt$start_year # we only ave pre-treatment
      dt[pre, ..keep]
    }, mc.cores = mc_cores) |>
      rbindlist(idcol = "r")
    end_all <- Sys.time()
    print(end_all - start_all)
    saveRDS(result, paste0("data/simulation/wcov/wcov_imputation_"
      , file_name, "_", k, ".rds"
    ))
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Fit and save GB-Ens for all three scenarios, adding the four standardized covariates as predictors.
preds <- c("uemp", "pov", "mhinc", "aian")

fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_xgb
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "xgb"
  ,  predictors = preds
)
```

```{r}
# Limit nested numerical threads, then fit and save the covariate-adjusted RW-ST model.
Sys.setenv(
  OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1,
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = 1,
  MKL_NUM_THREADS = 1
)
INLA::inla.setOption(num.threads = 1)
fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_inla
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 16, fit_fun = fit_sptiv_c
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "rwst"
)
```

```{r}
# Define covariate-adjusted TWFE/ETWFE formulas and fit TWFE for scenarios 2 and 3 only.
# The active worlds=2:3 call does not generate MAR TWFE results in this chunk.
fm_etwfe_c <- formula(y0 ~  uemp + pov + mhinc + aian
  | start_year[uemp + pov + mhinc + aian] + year[uemp + pov + mhinc + aian]
)
fm_twfe_c <- formula(y0 ~ 1
  + uemp + pov + mhinc + aian
  | i + year
)


fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_fe
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18, fm = fm_twfe_c
  , worlds = 2:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "twfe"
)
```

```{r}
# Fit and save covariate-adjusted ETWFE predictions for all three assignment scenarios.
fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_fe
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18, fm = fm_etwfe_c
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "etwfe"
)
```
